# Example 1: Identifying All Customers

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Example 1: Identifying All Customers

To list all customers, including those who haven't made any purchases, you need to ensure that every customer is included, even if they don't have associated purchase records.

To achieve this, use LEFT JOIN between the Customers and Orders tables. This join includes all customers and shows NULL for those without purchases, effectively identifying active and inactive customers.

```sql
1-- Left join the Customers and Orders tables
2
3SELECT Customers.customer_name, Customers.city, Orders.product_name
4FROM Customers
5LEFT JOIN Orders
6ON Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id;
```

Output

![SQL LEFT JOIN](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the query selects all the rows from Customers (left table) and the common rows from Orders (right table).
